title: 第十八章都是冲动惹的祸第十七章悬崖下的激情激情大戏求收藏
content_zh:
第十八章都是冲动惹的祸
陈林这个时候，轻轻的抱住顾飞燕说道“宝贝你还是穿上衣服吧，要不然我又会忍不住了”
说完陈林还色色的看着顾飞燕，接着在储物戒中拿了两套衣服，两人穿上衣服后，这才从裂缝中出来，现在已经是中午了，太阳升的老高。
“你对我做了什么，我是怎么提升的。快告诉我……”顾飞燕显然对自己提升很吃惊，因为她在这个阶位卡了很长时间了，现在刚刚达到九阶巅峰。
陈林听着顾飞燕撒娇似的声音，全身都素素的感觉，顿时飘飘线仙的说道“这算什么，这只是附带的，你修炼下试试！”
顾飞燕依言修炼了一下，顿时感觉修炼速度提升了近百倍，而且自己身体内的经脉变得更宽，经脉也变得更加的坚实，现在自己感觉冲击八阶，也只是几天的事，顿时呆愣在当场。
于是又开始向陈林，撒娇似的问着“你到底是怎么弄得，我现在的天赋变高了，修炼速度也变快了近百倍。”
不过这次陈林没有跟她说实话，而是胡诌了一段故事，说自己在诸神大陆上有一次奇遇，有一个神秘人给了自己一枚神奇的戒指，并且教会了自己这套双修功法。
其实顾飞燕的天赋本来就很高，因为在异界修炼的斗气很狂暴，这个世界的人都不知道，盲目的修炼对自己的经脉伤害很大，这些都是暗伤平时看不出来，但是一旦到了高阶以后，实力就会很难提升，这又就是为什么那么多九阶巅峰，却没有几个圣阶。
正是因为顾飞燕的实力已经是七阶高级，所以这次双修大部分的元气，都是在修补她的经脉。只有很少一部分改善了她的体质。
在听完陈林的故事后，顾飞燕被陈林忽悠一愣一愣的，陈林还嘱咐她以后，不要太过于追求提升速度。然后陈林又接着说道“现在你也是我的女人了，是不是改改口了，别老你你的！听着多别扭啊！”
“那叫什么？”
“要叫老公，知道吗！老婆！”
“死样，谁说要嫁给你了！”顾飞燕难得脸色绯红的低下头，不过接下来却有突然爆发般，反过来对着陈林说道“对了，我的第一次给你了，你以后就是我的人了，以后要是我知道你祸害别的小姑娘，我就阉了你！”
说完顾飞燕还那起手中的匕首挥了挥，看的陈林顿时感觉下面凉飕飕的。赶紧家住双腿陪笑道“我老婆这么漂亮，我怎么会找别人啊。”
顾飞燕的脸色这次恢复正常，又开始娇羞起来，不过陈林心中还在打怵“我不会是找了个母老虎吧，不是说异界都能妻妾成群的吗！这坑爹的吧！都是冲动惹的祸啊！”
早温存过后，在经过不断的查看，确认周围没有追杀的黑袍人后，两人开始爬上山顶，在上山后陈林和燕儿顾飞燕，以后都这么叫了，也终于松了口气。
因为陈林只有自己的随身衣服，所以燕儿也穿着陈林的衣服。因为燕儿已经二十五岁了，比十七岁的陈林还要高一点，穿起陈林的衣服也差不多，只是比较宽松。
不过陈林看着穿着男装的燕儿，顿时觉得她多了一股英武的气质，跟她原来的高贵大方、野性妖娆都不一样，看起来另有一种感觉，煞是好看！
一路上两人唧唧我我，不断的说说笑笑，很快就回到了飞燕寨，不过这次陈林是光明正大的进去的，从肉票成功的晋级到男寨主。

不过白天的飞燕寨更热闹，晚上所有来逃难的难民都睡下了，没什么，但是白天总不能老是睡觉吧，而且白天还有更多的难民来这里投奔。
整个山寨门口足有好几万人，这些人总要管饭吧！飞燕寨每天都会有免费的饭，早晚各一顿，不过这几万人的温饱，每天都会话费很多的钱。这也是为什么顾飞燕到处绑票的原因了。
人类是一个很奇特的种族，只要吃饱了没事干的时候，必定会有人惹事的，而且不论你对他们多好，只要是习惯了，他们就认为是理所应当的。
所以整个飞燕寨现在都是乱哄哄的一片，不断的有成群斗殴，在一旁不断叫骂的，不过更多的是一些坐在一旁无说事实的人。
在顾飞燕和陈林回来的时候，这些人都安静了下来，纷纷用敬畏的眼光看着顾飞燕，陈林看着这些人的表现，还有刚才的叫骂声，陈林的眉头紧锁着。
在回到了飞燕寨的山顶上，这里的情况就要好的多，没有乱哄哄的场面，所有的人都在收拾着东西，或是在一旁闲聊，顾飞燕回来后，还有很多人向她打招呼，还有不少的小孩围过来叫着“寨主姐姐，寨主姐姐”，这些人看向顾飞燕的眼神，没有那么多的敬畏，但却多了很多的感激。
陈林心道“人心可用啊，还是有知道记恩的人！”
在回到回到山顶后，顾飞燕也像是变了个人，很亲切的跟着周围的小孩说这话，不过很快就回到了自己的屋子，陈林也跟了进去。

Chapter 18 It’s all caused by impulse
At this time, Chen Lin gently hugged Gu Feiyan and said, "Baby, you'd better put on some clothes, otherwise I won't be able to bear it anymore."
After saying that, Chen Lin looked at Gu Feiyan lustfully, and then took two sets of clothes from the storage ring. After the two of them put on their clothes, they came out of the crack. It was already noon, and the sun was rising high.
"What did you do to me? How did I improve? Tell me..." Gu Feiyan was obviously surprised by her improvement, because she had been stuck at this level for a long time and had just reached the peak of the ninth level.
Listening to Gu Feiyan's coquettish voice, Chen Lin felt like his whole body was pure, and he suddenly said in an enchanting voice, "This is nothing, this is just incidental, you can try it after practicing!"
Gu Feiyan practiced as she was told, and immediately felt that her cultivation speed had increased nearly a hundred times, and the meridians in her body had become wider and stronger. Now she felt that it was only a few days since she reached the eighth level, and she was stunned on the spot.
So he started to ask Chen Lin coquettishly, "How did you do it? My talent is now higher, and my cultivation speed has become nearly a hundred times faster."
But this time, Chen Lin did not tell her the truth. Instead, he told a nonsense story, saying that he had an adventure on the continent of the gods, and a mysterious man gave him a magical ring and taught him this set of dual cultivation techniques.
In fact, Gu Feiyan's talent is already very high, because the fighting spirit cultivated in the other world is very violent. No one in this world knows that blind cultivation will do a lot of harm to one's own meridians. These are hidden injuries that cannot be seen at ordinary times, but once you reach a high level, it will be difficult to improve your strength. This is why there are so many ninth-level peaks, but few holy levels.
It is precisely because Gu Feiyan's strength is already at the seventh level, so most of the energy used in dual cultivation this time is repairing her meridians. Only a small amount improved her physique.
After listening to Chen Lin's story, Gu Feiyan was stunned for a moment after being fooled by Chen Lin. Chen Lin also told her not to pursue too much improvement speed in the future. Then Chen Lin went on to say, "Now you are also my woman. Have you changed your tune? Don't get older! It sounds so awkward!"
"What's that called?"
"I want to call you husband, you know! Wife!"
"Damn it, who said I wanted to marry you!" Gu Feiyan lowered her head with a rare blush, but then she suddenly burst out and said to Chen Lin, "By the way, I'll give you my first time. You will be mine from now on. If I know that you harm other little girls, I will castrate you!"
After saying that, Gu Feiyan waved the dagger in her hand, and Chen Lin suddenly felt a chill down there. He quickly stayed at home with his legs and said with a smile, "My wife is so beautiful, how could I find someone else?"
Gu Feiyan's face returned to normal this time, and she started to become shy again, but Chen Lin was still worried, "Isn't it possible that I found a tigress? Isn't it said that other worlds have wives and concubines? This is such a cheat! It's all caused by impulsiveness!"
After the early warm-up, and after constant checks to confirm that there were no men in black robes chasing them around, the two began to climb to the top of the mountain. After climbing the mountain, Chen Lin and Yan'er and Gu Feiyan, who would be called this from now on, finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Because Chen Lin only had his own clothes, Yan'er also wore Chen Lin's clothes. Because Yan'er is already twenty-five years old, a little taller than the seventeen-year-old Chen Lin, and the clothes he wears are similar to Chen Lin's, but they are looser.
However, when Chen Lin looked at Yan'er in men's clothing, he suddenly felt that she had a more heroic temperament, which was different from her original noble, generous, wild and enchanting appearance. She seemed to have another feeling, and she was really good-looking!
The two of them chatted with each other, kept talking and laughing, and soon returned to Feiyan Village, but this time Chen Lin went in openly, starting from the meat ticket.Successfully promoted to male village leader.
However, Feiyan Village is more lively during the day. All the refugees who come to escape at night have gone to bed. It's okay, but you can't sleep all the time during the day, and there are more refugees coming here to seek refuge during the day.
There are tens of thousands of people at the gate of the entire village. These people must take care of the food! Feiyan Village provides free meals every day, one in the morning and one in the evening. However, feeding and clothing these tens of thousands of people will cost a lot of money every day. This is also the reason why Gu Feiyan kidnaps people everywhere.
Human beings are a very peculiar race. As long as they are full and have nothing to do, someone will definitely cause trouble. And no matter how nice you are to them, as long as you are used to it, they will take it for granted.
Therefore, the entire Feiyan Village is now in chaos, with groups fighting constantly and people yelling and cursing on the sidelines, but most of them are people sitting on the sidelines without telling the truth.
When Gu Feiyan and Chen Lin came back, these people became quiet and looked at Gu Feiyan with awe. Chen Lin frowned at the performance of these people and the scolding just now.
After returning to the top of Feiyan Village, the situation here was much better. There was no chaos. Everyone was packing things or chatting on the side. After Gu Feiyan came back, many people greeted her, and many children gathered around and called "Sister Village Master, Sister Village Master". These people looked at Gu Feiyan with less awe, but with a lot more gratitude.
Chen Lin thought to himself, "People's hearts can be used. There are still people who know how to remember gratitude!"
After returning to the top of the mountain, Gu Feiyan seemed to have changed. She said this to the children around her very kindly, but soon returned to her house, and Chen Lin followed.
